    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = But the next leg of the trip was,

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:01.159

}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:20.060

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:59.139
    | text      = So why not like make the most of a bad situation?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:06.959
    | text      = So I'm living in that.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:08.920
    | text      = I propose a new word.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:10.540
    | text      = I call it irrationalize.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:12.420
    | text      = It's whenever you say some stuff to justify
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:14.779
    | text      = doing ridiculous things, but then call it normal.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:18.139
    | text      = Possibly, that possibly is what's going on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:21.100
    | text      = But if I didn't irrationalize,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:24.860
    | text      = then I wouldn't have gotten to try and take
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:28.920
    | text      = a wonderful little walk down the trail here
}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:36.060

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:40.259
    | text      = Jordan is nodding.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:41.980
    | text      = Beautiful.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:42.819
    | text      = I was not allowed to go to Christmas Lake
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:45.899
    | text      = because on the trail there, it's a gated community.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:50.600
    | text      = And there's a guard house with a Santa outside

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:12.019
    | text      = That is a metaphor for something

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:13.980
    | text      = about how they view American culture
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:16.579
    | text      = and the way that it absorbs any kind of holiday
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:19.459

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:23.259
    | text      = Yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:24.139
    | text      = That's the way that Santa feels.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:25.980
    | text      = It feels paternal.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:27.459

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = And it's unsettling. That's no good.

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = I don't like this town at all.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:38.579
    | text      = So I didn't make it over to Christmas Lake,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:40.819
    | text      = but I did walk along the trail as much as I could.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:44.939
    | text      = And I found a signpost that told the story
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:47.959
    | text      = of how this town came to be,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:51.540
    | text      = which is obviously a big part of my curiosity.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:54.560
    | text      = Like, why the fuck is there a town called Santa Claus
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:58.540
    | text      = in the middle of Indiana?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:00.160
    | text      = Why?
}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:02.000
    | text      = And it turns out that some people came over here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
